claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the brand name and model printed on the body.
The witness noted a full set of keys but did not confirm the count.
The item is an electronic keyboard of a size consistent with portability.

risks.proof: A video clip of a chromatic scale being played across the entire keyboard.
risks.if_unproven: as having multiple dead keys requiring repair

risks.risk: LCD screen failure or dead pixels
risks.proof: A clear photo of the LCD screen while the unit is powered on.
A clear photo of the rear connection panel.

risks.risk: Blown speakers or distorted audio output
risks.proof: A video clip with clear audio of the keyboard playing at high volume.
A photo of the power adapter and its label.
risks.if_unproven: as unit only, without power supply

proof_requests: Video of all keys being played to confirm functionality.
Photo of the device powered on showing the LCD screen.
Photo of the rear ports (Power, USB, Sustain, Phones).
Photo of the power adapter and any included accessories like a music rest.
response.reason: The witness has clearly identified the specific brand and model from the chassis, allowing for a valuation at its worst-case functional state.
